messages:
Ravi (AE): Heads-up — Sentinel AI POC blocked. Customer CISO insists on BYOK for the POC and wants a hard price cap for a 3-week dedicated eval. Need quick alignment or we'll lose momentum.

Tess (Sales Eng): BYOK for POC is heavy. Can we offer envelope-wrapping (customer-supplied wrapping key) instead? Faster and meets most auditor asks.

Hiro (Solutions): envelope-wrap is doable with config toggle + short infra work. Will require log-forwarding option for their SIEM.

Jules (Sec): envelope-wrap meets controls for key custody claims, but customer will ask for attestation about key lifecycle and rotation. I can draft a 1-pager. ETA 2h.

Ava (Finance): price cap — they asked $18k for 3 weeks on 3x A100 equiv. We can structure as a capped SOW credit: $16k credit + conversion incentive if they sign reserved by 30 days. Approve conditionally.

legal-bot: SOW credit template generated: /legal/drafts/sentinel-poc-credit-v1. Legal note: envelope-wrap ok for POC; full BYOK requires DPA & infra changes.

ops-bot: infra ticket created (#infra-9812) for envelope-key toggle + s3 log drop. ETA 5h. Assign owner.

Tess (Sales Eng): runbook: enable envelope-toggle, configure S3 log drop with lifecycle 14d, provision dedicated pool with usage cap and alerting. Revert plan: purge ephemeral caches after POC.

Ravi (AE): customer responded — they accept envelope approach if we provide key rotation statement and log-forwarding. They need final answers in 48h or they pause.

Jules (Sec): uploaded rotation attestation and short controls matrix to shared drive and sent link to customer.

Ava (Finance): greenlight $16k credit conditional on signed SOW and telemetry-sharing clause. I'll own the finance sign-off.

Hiro (Solutions): ops applied envelope-toggle in staging; waiting prod deploy window. Can push to prod in ~30m if infra ready.

ops-bot: deploy request #deploy-6721 scheduled; awaiting owner and approval.

Ravi (AE): customer confirmed they will wait 48h. If legal & ops deliver within window, no exec bridge. If not, escalate.

Tess (Sales Eng): I'll update POC doc with the credit, runbook, and next steps.

Ravi (AE): thanks team — I'll keep the customer updated.
